basic_profile.bio: Recently got into online gaming, particularly World of Warcraft PvP. Originally from Waterloo, Iowa, I spend most of my evenings battling it out in virtual arenas. During the day, I work as a junior analyst at a local financial firm. I enjoy reading about gaming strategies and stock markets. I'm single and often spend weekends exploring new video games or catching up on esports tournaments. Typically online from 6 PM to midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in finance, which sparked my interest in subreddits like OGIstock and nexusearth. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught, with a lot of trial and error in games like Rise of Nations on Roblox.
